testResults.name: live-event-recorder-lake-schema
testResults.result: 21 new focused tests with fakes (no network, no wall clock): a 30-minute equity recording reads back every part with exact lake schema and metadata equality and zero warnings; rotation boundaries for UTC-day crypto and XNYS equity sessions with gap-midpoint attribution; graceful flush and pre-shutdown partial-file readability; and error paths including earlier-session events raising. Every flush atomically replaces one complete readable Parquet part (tempfile, fsync, os.replace) under live/{deployment}/date=/asset_class=/data_type= with zstd Parquet 2.6 matching the lake writer, and an optional injected-clock flush interval ages pending rows

testResults.name: repository-wide-quality-gates
testResults.result: Repository-wide Ruff lint, format check, ty type check, and the complete pytest suite passed with 978 tests after wave integration

limitations: Per-flush part files rather than single-file append: whole-object replacement is the only atomic primitive at the storage boundary, memory stays bounded, and parity replay reads a partition's parts in name order
Live-source-unavailable fields carry documented sentinels (equity conditions/tape, option condition, blank venue for non-nullable exchange columns); non-integral equity and option sizes raise
